SCENE: A girl poses with her head slightly tilted back and half turned towards the camera. APPEARANCE: fair skin, neat eyebrows, green eyes. expressive eye and lip makeup: long, black arrows drawn towards the temples. false eyelashes are glued in bunches, creating a "prickly" effect in the style of anime (manga lashes). there are bright highlights of highlighter in the inner corners of the eyes. A classic thin black choker fits snugly around the neck. in the left ear (which is open), several earrings are visible: small rings and a pendant earring. BACKGROUND: The background is as simple as possible and does not distract attention from the model. This is a light (beige or light gray) monochrome wall of a living room. A small fragment of a ceiling mount or a lamp is visible in the upper right corner. the background is out of focus and in deep shadow. FORESHORTENING: the picture was taken from a lower angle (bottom up). this technique visually lengthens the neck line, emphasizes the chin and cheekbones, making the image more majestic and a little detached.
